name: Unity Polishing
goalName: Make the inspector more readable, improve code quality and resource management
goal: When creating a game, scripts, gameobjects and components can get quite messy when there are many. Some properties in scripts need to be public, while they are not interesting in the inspector. Furthermore, sloppy code and redundant code costs more resources, there must be a way to prevent the waste. Lastly, an empty error log is always nice to have.

result: I refactored code, removing unnecessary functions and variables. Hidden things in the inspector when they have to be public but not interesting. Replaced images with raw images in UI, as raw images are less expensive. I surpressed warnings when they cannot be and would not need to be resolved.
contribution: Now that the code is cleaned up and performance has been increased, the project runs better while using less resources and there is a clear and clean structure.
